convert_vq_diffusion_to_diffusers: run the CLI script to convert VQ-Diffusion checkpoints and configs to a diffusers VQDiffusionPipeline
build_vqvae_model_from_config: build a VQModel from a VQ-Diffusion original YAML config using vqvae_model_from_original_config
build_transformer_model_from_config: build a Transformer2DModel from VQ-Diffusion diffusion, transformer, and content embedding configs
convert_vqvae_checkpoint: convert a VQ-Diffusion VQVAE checkpoint to diffusers checkpoint format using vqvae_original_checkpoint_to_diffusers_checkpoint
convert_transformer_checkpoint: convert a VQ-Diffusion transformer checkpoint to diffusers checkpoint format using transformer_original_checkpoint_to_diffusers_checkpoint
